verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official MCP server (@unleash/mcp) that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags following best practices, and a probe confirms the docs MCP endpoint completes a full handshake. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the flag-management MCP server itself (only the docs-MCP handshake was runtime-verified, not the @unleash/mcp flag server), and no evidence of broader community adoption reports.
